the use of multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (mpMRI) in first-time prostate biopsy is safe, effective and feasible.

multiparametric MRI guidance for targeted prostate biopsy is associated with a significant reduction in the number of biopsies performed, an improvement in cancer detection rate, and an increase in the proportion of patients who are diagnosed with clinically significant prostate cancer.

the addition of MRI to TRUS-guided prostate biopsy is beneficial in the detection of prostate cancer.
